reason: I don't go looking in an app for someone to fix things in my house -- I ask in the building WhatsApp group and go with whoever a neighbour already used. A new app with 'verified' freelancers doesn't tell me what happens the day the plumber doesn't turn up.
objection: If the person doesn't show up, or shows up and does a shoddy job, do I actually get my money back, and from whom -- the app or the freelancer? That's not answered anywhere here.
would_change_my_mind: If someone in my own WhatsApp group had actually used it and vouched for a good experience, plus a clear written guarantee that a no-show or bad job gets refunded without a fight.
